topic_objective: Select an appropriate mechanics model, preserve dimensional consistency, convert SI units, report justified precision, follow a general analysis workflow, and recognize when virtual work is useful.
prerequisite_framing: Begin with algebra, trigonometry, vector notation, SI base and derived units, and the distinction between a particle and a rigid body. These are framing prerequisites, not replacements for the signed procedures.

procedure_overview.overview: Introduce mechanics model selection as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce particle vs rigid body modeling as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce units dimensional consistency as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce si unit conversion as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce numerical significant figures as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce general analysis procedure as a signed procedure within General Principles.
Introduce virtual work as a signed procedure within General Principles.

worked_example_entry_point.scenario: A loaded bracket is classified as a particle or rigid body, its governing quantities are written with consistent SI dimensions, and the analysis path is selected before calculation.
